福爾摩沙小導遊臺南 Tainan・大臺南

白河：蓮花、木棉道與泥漿溫泉Baihe: Lotus Fields, Kapok Road & Mud Hot Springs

白河在臺南的東北角，靠近嘉義，一年四季各有不同的風景。說到白河，台灣人第一個想到的就是蓮花：這裡是全台最大的蓮子和蓮藕產地，二百多公頃的蓮田大多集中在蓮潭、玉豐、廣安一帶。每年五月到八月是蓮花季，六月前後花開得最盛，一望無際的荷葉之間冒出一朵朵粉紅色的蓮花；花謝以後，花心長成像蓮蓬頭的蓮蓬，剝開就是白河有名的蓮子，泥裡的蓮藕則做成蓮藕粉和蓮藕麵。春天大約三月，林初埤旁一公里長的木棉道開滿橘紅色的花，清晨無風時，花影倒映在稻田水面上，美得像一條火焰隧道；不過這是一條真正的農路，記得禮讓耕耘機。再往山上走，就是關子嶺溫泉，這裡的溫泉水是灰色的，是台灣唯一的天然泥漿溫泉；附近的水火同源，天然氣從岩縫冒出來，火焰就在流動的水面上燃燒。來白河，賞完花、泡完湯，別忘了嚐嚐甕仔雞，再帶一包蓮子回家。

Baihe lies in the northeast corner of Tainan, near Chiayi, and every season brings a different view. For most Taiwanese, Baihe means lotus. It is the country's biggest grower of lotus seeds and lotus root, with more than two hundred hectares of lotus fields, mostly around Liantan and Yufeng. Lotus season runs from May to August and peaks around June, when pink flowers rise between endless green leaves. When the petals fall, the center becomes a seed pod that looks like a shower head, full of Baihe's famous lotus seeds, while the roots in the mud are made into powder and noodles. In spring, around March, a kilometer of kapok trees beside Linchu Pond bursts into orange-red bloom. On a still morning the flowers are mirrored in the flooded rice fields like a tunnel of fire, but this is a real farm road, so make way for the tractors. Up in the hills is Guanziling, where the hot spring water is grey: Taiwan's only natural mud hot spring. Nearby, at the Water-Fire Spring, natural gas seeps from the rock and flames dance on running water. After the flowers and the hot springs, try the clay-oven chicken and take home a bag of lotus seeds.

一分鐘看懂

One-minute intro

為什麼值得來

Why it matters & history

白河一年有三種風景：夏天是蓮花的季節，白河是全台最大的蓮子和蓮藕產地，二百多公頃的蓮田開滿粉紅花朵；春天林初埤一公里的木棉道燒成一片火紅；山上的關子嶺則是台灣唯一的天然泥漿溫泉，附近的水火同源，火焰就在水面上燃燒。

Baihe has three famous sights. In summer, more than two hundred hectares of lotus fields bloom pink, for Baihe is Taiwan's biggest grower of lotus seeds and lotus root. Each spring a kilometer of kapok trees turns a farm road scarlet. Up in the hills, Guanziling has Taiwan's only natural mud hot springs, near a spot where fire burns on water.

  1. 每年三月左右 Around March木棉花期只有兩三週，清晨無風時倒影最美。The kapok trees bloom for only two or three weeks; come on a still morning for reflections.
  2. 每年五到八月 May to August蓮花季：六月前後蓮花盛開，蓮田集中在蓮潭、玉豐、廣安一帶，還有四公頃多的蓮花公園。Lotus season: the flowers peak around June. The fields cluster around Liantan and Yufeng, along with a lotus park of over four hectares.
  3. 夏末秋初 Late summer採收蓮子、挖蓮藕，做成蓮子糕、蓮藕粉和蓮藕麵。Farmers harvest lotus seeds and dig up lotus root, which become sweets, lotus-root powder and noodles.
  4. 導覽員小提醒 Guide's tip木棉道是農路，要和耕耘機共用；賞蓮請清晨來，別忘了嚐甕仔雞、買白河蓮子。The kapok road is a working farm road; share it with tractors. See the lotus early in the morning, and try jar-roasted chicken and lotus seeds.

認識景點

About the place

木棉：在開花前先落葉。 農路、鄉間小路：林初埤的木棉種在一條高起農路的兩旁。 開花、花期：花期很短，通常在三月左右。 火焰隧道：盛開時，這條路變成一條火焰隧道。

kapok: The kapok drops its leaves before it flowers. country lane: At Linchupi, the trees line both sides of a raised farm lane. bloom: The bloom is short, usually around March. tunnel of fire: In peak season, the lane becomes a tunnel of fire.

倒影：清晨無風時來，看稻田水面上的倒影。 埤塘：林初埤是路旁一座老灌溉埤塘。 耕耘機：這條路要和真正開耕耘機的農夫共用。 攝影師：天還沒亮就到了。

reflection: Come at dawn for wind-still reflections in the paddy water. irrigation pond: Linchupi is an old irrigation pond beside the road. tractor: The road is shared with real farmers on real tractors. photographer: Photographers arrive before sunrise.

泥漿溫泉：關子嶺是台灣唯一的天然泥漿溫泉。 泥岩：灰色的泥來自地底的泥岩，和月世界是同一家族。 舀泥：首先，舀起沉澱的泥漿。 抹上：然後把泥漿抹在皮膚上。

mud spring: Guanziling is Taiwan's only natural mud spring. mudstone: The grey mud comes from deep mudstone, like Moon World's. scoop the mud: First, scoop the settled mud. apply: Then apply the mud to your skin.

讓它乾：一下。 沖洗：最後沖掉，皮膚會變得很滑。 水火同源：在水火同源，火焰就在流動的水面上跳舞。 天然氣：從崖壁的裂縫冒出來。

let it dry: Let it dry a little. rinse: Finally, rinse it off. Your skin will be silky. Water-Fire Spring: At Water-Fire Spring, flames dance directly on flowing water. natural gas: Natural gas seeps through a crack in the cliff.

甕仔雞：嚐嚐用甕烤的甕仔雞。 蓮花：夏天的白河蓮田開滿粉紅色的蓮花，六月前後最盛。 蓮田：白河有二百多公頃蓮田，是全台最大的蓮子和蓮藕產地。 蓮蓬：花謝以後，花心長成像蓮蓬頭的蓮蓬，裡面就是蓮子。

clay-oven chicken: Try a chicken roasted in a clay oven. lotus: In summer, the lotus fields of Baihe fill with pink flowers, best around June. lotus field: Baihe has over two hundred hectares of lotus fields, the most in Taiwan for lotus seeds and lotus root. seed pod: When the petals fall, the center becomes a seed pod that looks like a shower head, full of lotus seeds.

蓮藕：埋在泥裡的蓮藕可以煮湯，也做成蓮藕粉和蓮藕麵。 荷花就是蓮花：荷花和蓮花是同一種植物。習慣上，葉子和整株叫「荷」，蓮蓬、蓮子和蓮藕叫「蓮」，所以賞荷和賞蓮都對。 睡蓮不是蓮花：睡蓮是不同的植物：葉子有一道 V 形缺口、平貼在水面，花浮在水上，也不結蓮蓬。荷花的葉子是圓的、高高挺出水面，葉面不沾水，還會結蓮蓬。 蓮子：買一包白河蓮子帶在路上吃。

lotus root: Lotus root grows in the mud. It goes into soup and is made into lotus-root powder and noodles. lotus, two names: In Chinese, this flower has two names, he hua and lian hua, but they mean the same plant. People tend to use one name for the leaves and the other for the seeds and roots. water lily: A water lily is a different plant. Its leaves have a V-shaped notch and lie flat on the water, its flowers float, and it has no seed pods. Lotus leaves are round, stand high above the water and shed raindrops, and the flowers grow seed pods. lotus seeds: Buy a bag of Baihe lotus seeds for the road.

實景照片

Photos on site

白河的蓮田 Lotus fields of Baihe

夏天的白河，一望無際的蓮田開滿粉紅色的蓮花，大大的荷葉層層疊疊。白河是台灣種蓮花最有名的地方，大約六到八月是花期，每年都會舉辦蓮花節；清晨天氣涼、花開得最好，是賞蓮的好時間。

In summer, the lotus fields of Baihe stretch as far as you can see, full of pink flowers and huge overlapping leaves. Baihe is the best-known lotus-growing area in Taiwan. The flowers bloom from about June to August, and a lotus festival is held every year. Come early in the morning, when it is cool and the flowers are at their best.

蓮花與蓮蓬 Lotus flowers and seed pods

近看一朵盛開的蓮花：粉紅花瓣中間是黃色的花心。花謝以後，花心會長成像蓮蓬頭的蓮蓬，裡面一顆顆就是白河有名的蓮子；旁邊還有含苞的花苞和剛結出的小蓮蓬。

Up close, a lotus flower opens its pink petals around a yellow center. When the petals fall, the center grows into a seed pod that looks like a shower head. The seeds inside are Baihe's famous lotus seeds. Around it you can see closed buds and young seed pods.

含苞的荷花 Lotus buds

一大片荷葉之間，冒出許多粉紅和白色的花苞，像一支支毛筆的筆尖。荷花清晨開、午後漸漸合起，花苞要過幾天才會完全綻放，所以賞荷最好一大早來。

Pink and white buds rise between the big leaves, shaped like the tips of writing brushes. Lotus flowers open in the morning and close again in the afternoon, and a bud takes a few days to open fully, so come early to see them.

傍晚的荷田 The lotus field at dusk

傍晚時分的荷田：圓圓的荷葉挺出水面，花苞在晚風中搖晃，遠方樹林後露出一座廟的屋頂。夏天傍晚涼爽，也是在田邊散步的好時間。

The lotus field at dusk: round leaves stand above the water, buds sway in the evening breeze, and a temple roof peeks out behind the trees. Summer evenings are cool, a good time for a walk along the fields.

比一比：睡蓮 Compare: water lilies

這是睡蓮，不是荷花。仔細看葉子：每片都有一道 V 形缺口，平平貼在水面上；粉紅色的花浮在水面或只高出一點點。對照前面荷田的照片，荷葉圓圓的、沒有缺口，高高挺出水面。

These are water lilies, not lotus. Look at the leaves: each has a V-shaped notch and lies flat on the water, and the pink flowers float on the surface or rise just a little. Compare them with the lotus field photos, where the round leaves have no notch and stand high above the water.

比一比：滿池睡蓮 Compare: a pond of water lilies

一整池睡蓮，白色和淡紫色的花瓣尖尖的，中間是黃色花心。睡蓮的花謝了不會長出蓮蓬，也沒有蓮子和蓮藕；荷花才會結蓮蓬。

A whole pond of water lilies, with pointed white and pale purple petals around yellow centers. When a water lily fades it leaves no seed pod, and it gives no lotus seeds or lotus root. Only the lotus grows seed pods.

比一比：柳樹下的睡蓮池 Compare: a water lily pond

柳樹下的小池塘裡，睡蓮的圓葉一片片平鋪在水面上，像一個個盤子，粉紅色的花只比葉子高一點。睡蓮常種在公園和校園的小池塘裡；荷花則多種在大片的田裡。

In this small pond under willow trees, the water lily leaves lie flat on the water like plates, and the pink flowers rise only a little above them. Water lilies are often grown in small ponds in parks and schoolyards, while lotus is usually farmed in big fields.

比一比：各色睡蓮 Compare: water lilies of many colors

同一個池子裡，開著白色、淡紫色和粉紅色的睡蓮。睡蓮的顏色比荷花多，白、粉、黃、紫、藍都有；荷花大多是粉紅或白色。

White, pale purple and pink water lilies bloom in the same pond. Water lilies come in more colors than lotus, including white, pink, yellow, purple and blue, while lotus flowers are mostly pink or white.

散步路線

Walking route

需開車或搭車 By car or bus在臺南市區外，需要開車或搭車前往。
It is outside central Tainan, so you will need a car, bus or taxi.
